request.description: Items include tree_path (ltree) for DFS order and admin table name indent.
product.product_category.view — related brand picker on category form.
Items include tree_path (ltree) for DFS order and admin table name indent.
Browse rows include aggregates: total_stock, low_stock, warehouse_root_count, car_count, car_summary, and optional cover_system_file_id (first product_item_file for the item).
product.product_list.view — facet=categories|brands for list toolbar comboboxes.
Bulk bar uses is_stopped: false to resume sales.
Rows: placement_id, bin_id, warehouse→bin path labels, aggregated quantity (lot form bin picker).
Paginated product_item_stock rows for lot dialog on product list form.

Creates a lot; bin_id must match an existing product_item_warehouse placement for this item (400 validation if missing). Rejects alternate-SKU items (old_product_item_id set). Optional po_sku resolves purchase_order_item_id for this product_item. Server snapshots active setting_vat vat_type + rate onto product_item_stock.
Optional received_at (ISO or YYYY-MM-DD), supplier_user_id (null clears), po_sku (trimmed PO number → purchase_order_item_id for this product_item; empty clears PO link).

Aggregate includes product_list.updated_at (ISO timestamp) for form sidebar last-updated display. Each items[] entry includes read-only total_stock, warehouse_root_count, low_stock, and files[] (product_item_file).

product.product_list.view — facets: categories, brands, suppliers, sale_channels, warehouse_bins, cars (cars: type_car + parent_id). sale_channels items: id, name, optional is_default, sort_order, system_file_id (channel logo).

request.description: member.member_setting_business.view — business form pickers; facet=groups for group multi-combobox
member.member_tier.view — profile combobox for tier relation dialog without member_setting_business.view
member.member_user.view — always total_customers, active_members, new_this_month; sales_this_month only when JWT user_type is superadmin
member.member_user.view — cascade credit/group options for a business (form profile row).
member.member_user.view — includes business_id, credit_id, group_id on each item; ?id= for hydrate.
member.member_user.view — address geo picker for member user form (no admin.system_province.view required).
member.member_user.view — cascade districts under system_province_id.
member.member_user.view — cascade sub-districts under system_district_id.
member.member_user.view — discount product picker; optional brand_id and category_id.
member.member_user.view — brand-linked categories plus ancestors and descendants (parent_id, sort_order on items).

Aggregate includes read-only `setting_prefix_name` and `website_*_name` on the root and each `addresses[]` row (locale labels for view-only UI), `files[]` (junction + embedded `system_file`), and `histories[]` with locale `title` (+ optional `names` th/en). History rows append on member create, file create, and discount create.
Also appends a `member_history` entry (document uploaded).
Also appends a `member_history` entry (special discount added).

member.member_user.create — omit `sku` (or null) to auto-assign from `system_code_prefix` (`member_user` → e.g. MEM-202603-00001). Send explicit `sku` to override. Inserts initial `member_history` (member created).
supplier.supplier_user.view — facet=prefixes|banks for form comboboxes.
